name: DMA Stream Planner
blurb: peripherals assigned to DMA streams and channels on an STM32, with the conflicts shown
intro: Places the DMA requests you need on the streams or channels that are actually wired to them - from the request tables in ST's reference manuals, as stored in STM32CubeMX's device database - finds the clashes and the requests that cannot be placed, and writes the CubeMX list, HAL init code and IRQ handlers.

inputs.label: Requests
inputs.default:
USART2_RX high
USART2_TX
I2C1_RX
I2C1_TX
SPI2_TX medium
DAC1
SPI1_RX veryhigh
SPI1_TX veryhigh
ADC1 high
SDIO medium
inputs.help: One per line: NAME [low|medium|high|veryhigh] [@DMA2_S3]. @ pins it to that stream/channel; without it the solver picks. MEMTOMEM for a memory-to-memory stream. Timer events may be named alone (TIM2_UP).

examples.title: F407 board: UARTs, I2C, SPI, DAC and ADC - DAC1 and USART2_RX both need DMA1 Stream5

input.requests:
USART2_RX high
USART2_TX
I2C1_RX
I2C1_TX
SPI2_TX medium
DAC1
SPI1_RX veryhigh
SPI1_TX veryhigh
ADC1 high
SDIO medium

examples.title: STM32L476: two UARTs, SPI2, ADC1 and a timer, one pinned by hand

input.requests:
USART1_RX high
USART1_TX
USART2_RX high
USART2_TX
SPI2_RX veryhigh @DMA1_C4
SPI2_TX veryhigh
ADC1 medium
TIM2_UP

usage: Give family (f407, f746, f103md, f103hd, f072, l073, l476, g474, h743, l4r5, u575) and requests, one per line as NAME [priority] [@DMA2_S3] (names as in the reference manual: USART2_RX, SPI1_TX, ADC1, TIM2_UP, MEMTOMEM). Returns the placement table (stream/channel, CHSEL or request selector, priority, IRQ, status), warnings for clashes, unknown names and requests that cannot be placed with who holds their streams, and texts with the CubeMX list, HAL_DMA_Init code and IRQ handlers. Use it before writing DMA init code or when a peripheral's DMA 'does nothing' because another one owns its stream.
sources: ST RM0090 §10.3.3 and Tables 42/43 (STM32F405/407 DMA1/DMA2 request mapping, arbitration)
ST RM0008 §13.3 and Tables 78/79 (STM32F10x DMA1/DMA2 requests)
ST RM0091 §10 (STM32F0x1/x2/x8 DMA), RM0367 §11 (STM32L0x3 DMA/CSELR), RM0351 §11 (STM32L4x5/x6 DMA/CSELR)
ST RM0440 (G4), RM0432 (L4+), RM0433 (H742/743/753) DMAMUX request tables; RM0456 §17 (U5 GPDMA)
STM32CubeMX device database db/mcu/IP/DMA-*_Modes.xml, GPDMA-STM32U5_dma3_Cube_Modes.xml and NVIC-*_Modes.xml (request lines, CHSEL/CSELR values, IRQ names), filtered by each part's peripherals
